findings.mechanism: 01-what-a-connection-actually-costs — a new AsyncClient per call forces a cold TLS handshake each request, incurring DNS, TCP and TLS round‑trips before any payload.
findings.remediation: Instantiate a single httpx.AsyncClient at module load (or via dependency injection) with appropriate connection limits and reuse it for all charge calls instead of creating a new client per request.
findings.arithmetic: Assume internal RTT R=30 ms. Warm request latency ≈R (30 ms). Cold request adds DNS+TCP+TLS round‑trips ≈3R, total ≈4R (120 ms). Extra latency ≈4R‑R=3R=90 ms. Therefore the 99th‑percentile request latency will be at least 90 ms higher when the per‑request client pattern is used.
